messages:
alex: Ticket C-7058 — customer reports streaming (EventSource) in Safari drops when tab loses focus. Partial event payloads, client reconnects but resumes from scratch (KV cache gone).

alex: Repro steps I used:
1) Open Mac Safari 16.3
2) Start streaming via our hosted API endpoint: GET https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream?model=x
3) Switch tab / lock screen for ~30s
4) Return -> EventSource fires 'error' then reconnects but stream restarts mid-response

alex: curl to repro (shows 304 from CDN sometimes):
```
curl -i "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream?conv_id=abc" -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>"
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Date: Tue, 12 Sep 2026 21:15:00 GMT
Transfer-Encoding: chunked
Cache-Control: max-age=0, must-revalidate
ETag: "abc123"

<... chunked event frames ...>
```

maya: Do we have the browser console + network waterfall? Can you paste full response headers on reconnect? Are requests going through CDN/Cloudfront or Cloudflare?

alex: Customer uses Fastly in front of us. Network log on reconnect shows conditional GET with `If-None-Match: "abc123"` -> 304 from Fastly, then client sees connection close. Console shows `EventSource failed: Connection closed` on focus.

jules: Fastly returning 304 for EventSource is suspicious — SSE endpoints should be no-store/no-cache. Likely our origin sends ETag and Fastly honors it for subsequent conditional requests. Quick fix: set `Cache-Control: no-store, no-transform` on /v1/stream endpoints. Also ensure `Vary` doesn't include headers clients set intermittently.

samir: Safari is aggressive about background tabs. In some versions it will pause JS and suspend sockets; combined with a 304 it may not resume correct framing. Long-term: add keepalive ping frames and fallback to WebSocket if EventSource fails. Short-term customer workaround: append a cache-busting query param on client when resuming: `?conv_id=abc&_ts=TIMESTAMP`.

maya: Could we also add an edge rule (Fastly) to always pass-through cache for path starting with `/v1/stream`? Engineering, is that safe for hosted tenants? :thinking:

jules: Edge rule is safe for streaming endpoints; cost-wise minimal. I'll open an infra PR to add a pass-through for `^/v1/stream` and set `Cache-Control: no-store` at origin. Also will add a note in docs about Safari tab-suspend behavior and recommended client fallbacks.

support_bot: Ticket C-7058 updated: engineering oncall assigned (@samir). Customer informed of workaround (cache-bust) :white_check_mark:.

alex: Thanks — I'll relay workaround to customer and keep thread updated. :thumbsup:
